text:
matt: heads-up converting the quickstart to the Go SDK. hit multiple parity surprises vs the curl examples: health check path mismatch, auth header dropped on health call, and response-code wrapping so 503 becomes 500 in the SDK.

zoe: can you paste the tiny repro?

matt: curl that works from docs:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# 200 {"status":"ok"}
```

matt: Go SDK quickstart snippet:```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
_, err := client.Health.Check(ctx)
```

matt: SDK call hits `/healthz` (no /v1 prefix) and server logs show no Authorization header for that call. Result: 401 from gateway. When I manually call the same endpoint with curl it's 200.

liam: interesting. Do we have health as an unauth endpoint upstream? I thought health required auth now. Maybe the SDK used the old unauth path and the client HTTP layer forgot to attach the token for health checks.

tara: also want to flag the error wrapping - when the server returns 503 under load the SDK surfaces a generic `internal error (500)` making it hard for apps to implement retry/backoff. curl preserves 503.

zoe: that's a DX problem for ops. Any param drift?

matt: yes: the Go SDK uses `ModelName` in the request struct and the serializer sends `ModelName` instead of `model_name`. Server ignores it, falls back to default model, causing subtle quality regressions in sample runs.

liam: three separate bugs then: 1) health path/version and missing auth header, 2) serializer not snake_casing fields for wire, 3) error code mapping/wrapping.

tara: actionable plan: liam to grep Go client for `healthz` and auth attach point; zoe to open issue with minimal repro for serializer / field casing; matt to attach logs showing 503->500 mapping to an issue. We'll aim for a patch release if small.

matt: temporary workarounds I used: call health via raw curl from sample app to avoid SDK health check, and explicitly set model via REST until serializer patch lands. Not great for quickstart though.

dx-bot: Created issue redwood/go-sdk#78: "Go SDK: health endpoint path/auth mismatch, serializer sends camelCase keys, and 503 status wrapped as 500" https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/78

zoe: good catch. I'll add a note in onboarding docs mentioning the raw curl workaround until we cut a fix.

matt: thanks team :thumbsup:
